pages.title: Persistent Long Cache
pages.text: Every source first materializes into its persistent cache. Automation, manual extraction and storage buses draw only from that cache; a paid source spends Immortal Power only for a cache shortfall. Disabled faces stop active push but never hide standard capabilities.

Each face independently chooses Push, Bypass-limit Push or Disabled and has its own numeric tick rate. Fluid sources always accept and void any incoming fluid. Inventory icons show the output in the lower-right, preferring a filled bucket for fluids.

The Source Block Manager exists only in its owner's realm. It has 72 single-item slots and allows one source of each name. It aggregates extraction into the Xianqiao directory while every member keeps independent behavior and cache.
